reference_text: No added sugar. Sounds like sugar-free... right? Well... not quite. Fruit juice can still contain sugar from the fruit. So turn the pack over. Check total sugars, then compare similar drinks per hundred millilitres. Small flip. Better information.
script: In 2009, young scientists investigated fifteen detox products.
Two questions for their makers. What does detox mean? And where's the proof?
No two companies defined it the same way. Most offered no evidence.
Oh, and one product? A hair straightener.
So before buying a cleanse, ask what it's actually meant to remove.
Detox diets lack convincing evidence for removing toxins.
Your liver processes harmful substances; your kidneys filter waste.
